rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a brain-inspired personal AI agent platform focused on private, local-first consumer AI, while Saurabh is an AI Engineer at HiJenny AI with hands-on experience shipping AI-adjacent tools and agentic systems. intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Saurabh Khire — you're both shipping in consumer AI and share overlap in Python/TypeScript; Saurabh's backend and agentic tooling experience could complement your work on TinyHumans' architecture.
